arxiv-2012-02659.title: Understanding Attention: In Minds and Machines
arxiv-2012-02659.creator: Shriraj P. Sawant, Shruti Singh 0
arxiv-2012-02659.description: Abstract Attention is a complex and broad concept, studied across multiple disciplines spanning artificial intelligence, cognitive science, psychology, neuroscience, and related fields. Although many of the ideas regarding attention do not significantly overlap among these fields, there is a common theme of adaptive control of limited resources.

arxiv-2311-13073.title: FusionFrames: Efficient Architectural Aspects for Text-to-Video Generation Pipeline
arxiv-2311-13073.creator: Vladimir Arkhipkin, Zein Shaheen, Viacheslav Vasilev, Elizaveta Dakhova, Andrey Kuznetsov, Denis Dimitrov
arxiv-2311-13073.description: Abstract Multimedia generation approaches occupy a prominent place in artificial intelligence research. Text-to-image models achieved high-quality results over the last few years. However, video synthesis methods recently started to develop. This paper presents a new two-stage latent diffusion text-to-video generation architecture based on the text-to-image diffusion model.

arxiv-2412-02963.title: Solar System Migration Points to a Renewed Concept: Galactic Habitable Orbits
arxiv-2412-02963.creator: Junichi Baba, Takuji Tsujimoto, Takayuki R. Saitoh
arxiv-2412-02963.description: Abstract Astrophysical evidence suggests that the Sun was born near 5 kpc from the Galactic center, within the corotation radius of the Galactic bar, around 6–7 kpc. This presents challenges for outward migration due to the Jacobi energy constraint, preventing stars from easily overcoming the corotation barrier.

arxiv-2503-22863.title: The Gaia AVU–GSR solver: a CPU + GPU parallel code toward Exascale systems
arxiv-2503-22863.creator: Valentina Cesare, Ugo Becciani, Alberto Vecchiato, Mario Gilberto Lattanzi, Marco Aldinucci, Beatrice Bucciarelli
arxiv-2503-22863.description: Abstract The solver module of the Astrometric Verification Unit – Global Sphere Reconstruction (AVU–GSR) pipeline aims to find the astrometric parameters of ∼ \sim 10 8 10^{8} stars in the Milky Way, besides the attitude and instrumental settings of the Gaia satellite and the parametrized post Newtonian parameter γ \gamma with a resolution of 10-100 micro-arcseconds.

arxiv-2506-24011.title: The Lifespan of our Universe
arxiv-2506-24011.creator: and S.-H. Henry Tye
arxiv-2506-24011.description: Abstract The Dark Energy Survey (DES) and the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) measurements claim that the dark energy equation of state w ≠ − 1 w\neq-1 . This observation can be explained by the axion Dark Energy (aDE) model of an ultralight axion plus a cosmological constant Λ \Lambda .

arxiv-2509-19751.title: Determining Ideal Fields for Epoch of Reionisation Science Using the 21 cm Line
arxiv-2509-19751.creator: E. Jong, C. M. Trott, C. D. Nunhokee, Q. Zheng
arxiv-2509-19751.description: Abstract The upcoming Square Kilometre Array Low Frequency (SKA-Low) interferometer will have the required sensitivity to detect the 21 cm line from neutral hydrogen during the Epoch of Reionisation (EoR). In preparation, we investigated the suitability of different fields for EoR science with the 21 cm line, using existing observations of candidate fields from the Murchison Widefield Array (MWA).

arxiv-2602-13551.title: Small Reward Models via Backward Inference
arxiv-2602-13551.creator: Yike Wang ♡ Faeze Brahman ♠ Shangbin Feng ♡ Teng Xiao ♠
arxiv-2602-13551.description: Abstract Reward models (RMs) play a central role throughout the language model (LM) pipeline, particularly in non-verifiable domains. However, the dominant LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm relies on the strong reasoning capabilities of large models, while alternative approaches require reference responses or explicit rubrics, limiting flexibility and broader accessibility.

pmc-10605785.title: DALK combined intralamellar tectonic patch graft: an alternative approach to treat frank corneal perforation
pmc-10605785.creator: Gege Xiao, Hanzhi Ben, Shaofeng Gu, Jing Hong
pmc-10605785.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundDeep anterior lamellar keratoplasty (DALK) has gained popularity in cases of corneal thinning and leaking descemetocele. In this study, we introduced an intralamellar tectonic patch graft in addition to conventional DALK procedures to treat frank cornea perforation.MethodsThis retrospective case series included 13 patients (13 eyes) with frank corneal perforations who underwent DALK combined with intralamellar tectonic patch graft between December 2015 and December 2021.

pmc-11314107.title: Targeted Polymeric Micelles System, Designed to Carry a Combined Cargo of L-Asparaginase and Doxorubicin, Shows Vast Improvement in Cytotoxic Efficacy
pmc-11314107.creator: Igor D Zlotnikov, Elena V Kudryashova, Chi-Jung Chang
pmc-11314107.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). L-asparaginases (ASP) and Doxorubicin (Dox) are both used in the treatment of leukemia, including in combination. We have attempted to investigate if their combination within the same targeted delivery vehicle can make such therapy more efficacious. We assembled a micellar system, where the inner hydrophobic core was loaded with Dox, while ASP would absorb at the surface due to electrostatic interactions.

pmc-12395738.title: Extracellular vesicles in intestinal protozoa: hidden mediators of host-parasite communication
pmc-12395738.creator: Manouchehr Fadaee, Masoud Lahouty, Fatemeh Ramzi, Fatemeh Alizadeh, Sima Roshanfar, Tohid Kazemi, Adel Spotin, Kareem Hatam-Nahavandi, Ehsan Ahmadpour
pmc-12395738.description: Intestinal protozoan parasites, including, Cryptosporidium spp., Giardia duodenalis, Entamoeba histolytica, and Blastocystis sp. pose significant global health challenges, particularly in developing regions with limited access to sanitation and healthcare resources. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) have emerged as critical factors for communication in the complex interplay between intestinal protozoan parasites and their hosts.

pmc-12563467.title: Regional and Temporal Variation in Receipt of Gabapentinoid and SSRI/SNRI Therapy Among Older Cancer Survivors in the United States
pmc-12563467.creator: Amber Nguyen, Yong-Fang Kuo, Daoqi Gao, Mukaila Raji
pmc-12563467.description: Simple SummaryMany older cancer survivors experience pain and anxiety, which are often treated with opioids and benzodiazepines. However, due to concerns about the risk of these medications, doctors have increasingly prescribed alternatives such as gabapentinoids (e.g., gabapentin) and antidepressants such as SSRIs and SNRIs.

pmc-12644623.title: Identification of SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro inhibitors from marine actinomycetes through integrated phylogeny-based metabolomics with functional screening and bioinformatic analysis
pmc-12644623.creator: Doralyn S Dalisay, Jomari C Mateo, Jade Joshua R Teodosio, Lucille Marie S Jusa, Diane Monique S Baladjay, Leighiara S de Guzman, Lex Aliko P Balida, Jamia Azdina Jamal
pmc-12644623.description: As the acute threat of the COVID-19 pandemic diminishes globally, advancing the research and development of antiviral agents remains crucial for ensuring preparedness for future outbreaks. This study investigates the inhibitory effects of marine sediment-derived actinomycetes on the SARS-CoV-2 main protease (3CLpro), a key enzyme involved in viral replication and transcription.

pmc-12790751.title: Leptospirosis Complicated by Haemorrhagic Cardiac Tamponade: A Challenging Case of Weil’s Disease
pmc-12790751.creator: Stephanie Walsh, Pamela McGibbon, Christopher Loew
pmc-12790751.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection with a worldwide distribution. It is most commonly transmitted through exposure to water contaminated with the urine of infected rodents. It is a biphasic illness consisting of an initial acute febrile phase lasting up to seven days, followed by a second immune phase with symptoms of organ involvement and widespread vasculitis lasting up to 30 days. Cardiac involvement, including arrhythmias and myopericarditis, is a recognised complication of leptospirosis.

pmc-12816752.title: Oxidative DNA damage induced by 3,4-diOH-TAM, a tamoxifen metabolite, in relation to endometrial carcinogenesis
pmc-12816752.creator: Yurie Mori, Kaoru Midorikawa, Shinji Oikawa, Kiyoshi Fukuhara, Shosuke Kawanishi, Mariko Murata
pmc-12816752.description: Tamoxifen (TAM) is a non-steroidal anti-estrogen used widely in the treatment of breast cancer. However, long-term use of TAM increases the risk of endometrial cancer. To clarify the molecular mechanism of carcinogenesis, we examined DNA damage by TAM and its metabolites, 4-hydroxytamoxifen (4-OH-TAM), 3-hydroxytamoxifen (3-OH-TAM) and 3,4-dihydroxytamoxifen (3,4-diOH-TAM).

pmc-13266226.title: Efficacy of a hybrid psychoeducational and skills-based therapy (Trauma PORTAL) for adults with PTSD related to childhood interpersonal trauma: a parallel-group, randomised controlled trial
pmc-13266226.creator: Dana C. Ross, Negar Sayrafizadeh, Louloua Ashikhusein Waliji, Kaniz Farhat, Annie K. Truuvert, Mahum Musheer, Simone N. Vigod, Cherry Chu, Sophie Soklaridis, David Rojas, Nancy McCallum
pmc-13266226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryBackgroundMany adults with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) related to childhood interpersonal trauma (CIT) face substantial barriers to care and limited access to trauma-specific treatment. We evaluated the efficacy of the Trauma PORTAL (Providing Online tRauma Therapy using an Asynchronous Learning platform), a trauma-focused hybrid therapy integrating self-paced psychoeducational and skills-based modules and virtual therapist-led group sessions, to reduce PTSD symptoms in adults with a history of CIT.MethodsThis randomised, assessor-masked, controlled, parallel-group trial was conducted at a single site in Ontario, Canada.
